verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax portal with a sanctioned software channel, so issuing scoped credentials to an automated client is a fair axis. The evidence shows no way to mint least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The only credential described is the all-purpose ELSTER certificate from a one-time registration, used to sign filings and log in to online services. The scoped mechanisms it does mention, mailbox delegates (Postfachvertreter) and powers of attorney (Vollmachten), are human delegation features, not scoped API tokens.
